title: India and Malaysia Discuss Maritime Security in New Delhi Talks
summary: India and Malaysia held their 11th naval staff talks in New Delhi to discuss ways to enhance maritime security in the Indian Ocean. The discussions focused on cooperation between the two nations, including defense industry collaboration, cybersecurity, and disaster relief. Both countries agreed to strengthen their ties in these areas.
summary_points: India and Malaysia held the 11th naval staff talks in New Delhi
The talks aimed to boost Indian Ocean maritime security
Cooperation between India and Malaysia was discussed
Defense industry collaboration, cybersecurity, and disaster relief were key topics
Both countries agreed to strengthen their ties in these areas

summary_hi: भारत और मलेशिया ने अपनी 11वीं नौसेना कर्मचारी बैठक नई दिल्ली में हुई, जिसमें भारतीय महासागर में सुरक्षा को मजबूत करने पर चर्चा हुई। इस बैठक में भारत और मलेशिया के बीच सहयोग पर चर्चा हुई, जिसमें रक्षा उद्योग सहयोग, साइबर सुरक्षा, और आपदा प्रबंधन शामिल थे। दोनों देशों ने इन क्षेत्रों में अपनी संबंधों को मजबूत करने का फैसला किया।
